brief: Test whether a regular expression matches
description: Checks whether the regular expression matches anywhere in value and returns the boolean result, as ECMAScript's re.test(s) does: re->test(s). Anchor with ^ and \z to match the whole value. value can be any value whose data type holds text, such as string, anyURI, dnsName, ipAddress, rfc822Name and x500Name.

parameters.description: The regular expression. A regexp literal (/a+b/ or "a+b"re), to_regexp(s), or compile<regexp>(r) is already compiled; any other regexp value is compiled for this call.
parameters.name: regexp

parameters.description: The value to search. Its data type must hold text.
parameters.name: value

returns.description: True if the regular expression matches anywhere in value.
